run.title: LongMemEval full-suite preflight decisions
run.goal: Lock scoring, thresholds, isolation, capacity, concurrency, and failure taxonomy before phased LongMemEval-S experimentation.

dataset.name: LongMemEval-S cleaned
dataset.selection_strategy: Phase-gated deterministic selection: 3 known-hard calibration cases, 10-case stratified pilot, 50-case subset, then full 500-case LongMemEval-S.

scoring.method: LongMemEval evaluate_qa rubric adapted to Azure GPT-5-family judges; primary judge gpt-5.4, calibration cross-check with gpt-5.4-mini-memory.
scoring.notes: Not comparable to published LongMemEval scores because GPT-4o is disallowed and answer/judge may both use GPT-5.4. Treat as a GPT-5-family judge/self-consistency score. Judge prompt source hash: ECCE9C4C79DC89D99534AC17B383A5CBB5B9F0C69EE98ADAF0684742E3D95251.

cost.note: User approved no cost cap; still estimate cost and token usage for planning.

caveats: GPT-4o and GPT-4o-mini are disallowed by user decision.
Preflight does not run benchmark cases; it only locks decisions and captures baseline state.
Dev environment uses public-network allowances for calibration/pilot; production should use private networking.
Summarization-specific routing remains partly unverified because some worker paths still resolve through default deployment.
Judge is GPT-5-family, not the upstream GPT-4o judge; scores are not directly comparable to published LongMemEval numbers.
Worker uses the same shared container image as the API with a worker command override; this is expected in current deployment.
next_gate: Implement Phase 1: 3-case calibration with GPT-5.4 judge scoring and fresh synthetic user IDs per case.
